lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct, high-contrast vertical white line segments traversing the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, with a slight decrease in inter-line distance towards the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (anterior) and lines 10-11 (posterior) are abbreviated, terminating before the ventral boundary. Line 5 and line 10 exhibit mid-segment breaks/fragmentation.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two primary white spots are visible on the lower haunch/upper hind limb area. One larger circular spot is located centrally on the haunch, with a smaller secondary spot located inferiorly.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Straight, conical horn silhouettes projecting at a ~60-degree angle relative to the skull's frontal plane, showing minimal lyrate curvature.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.8 times the pixel width of the horn bases.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron marking on the nasal bridge; two distinct white patches on the lower neck/throat; white 'stocking' markings on the distal limbs starting above the carpal and tarsal joints.
